user.title: Connect to n8n
user.description: Enter the base URL of your self-hosted n8n instance and an API key. The connection is validated against the n8n Public API.

data_description.api_key: Create a dedicated key in n8n Settings → API
data_description.verify_ssl: Disable only for trusted LAN self-signed certificates

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate n8n
reauth_confirm.description: The n8n API key was rejected. Enter a new API key.

error.invalid_url: Enter a full URL including http:// or https://

abort.already_configured: This n8n instance is already configured

init.title: n8n options
init.description: Poll interval, workflow filters (empty allowlists = expose all), and inbound webhook secrets. Multiple secrets can authenticate the same webhook URL. Newly created secrets are shown once in a notification — existing values are never re-displayed. Secrets never appear on entity attributes.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll n8n (30–300 seconds). Default 60.
data_description.workflow_allowlist: Comma-separated workflow ids. Empty = all (unless a tag allowlist is set).
data_description.tag_allowlist: Comma-separated n8n tag names (e.g. ha-exposed). Empty = no tag filter.
data_description.execution_history_limit: How many recent executions to fetch for last-run sensors and the failed count (1–250).
data_description.inbound_secret_action: none = leave secrets unchanged; create = mint a new secret (shown once); revoke = disable one secret by id; rotate = create + revoke (all others if no id, or the selected id).
data_description.inbound_secret_label: Label for a newly created/rotated secret (e.g. kitchen-wf).
data_description.inbound_secret_id: Secret id for revoke/rotate. See diagnostics for id/label metadata (values redacted).

error.secret_id_required: Select a secret id to revoke
error.secret_revoke_failed: Could not revoke that secret (unknown id or it is the last remaining secret)

stale_inbound_webhook.title: n8n inbound webhook may be stale ({entry_title})
stale_inbound_webhook.description: Home Assistant rejected several inbound n8n webhook requests because no active shared secret matched. Update X-N8N-HA-Secret in n8n, or use **Fix issue** to rotate (create a new secret, revoke previous ones, and show the new value once).

trigger_workflow.name: Trigger workflow
trigger_workflow.description: Trigger an n8n workflow via webhook or Public API execute. Use this service (not the Run button) to pass a JSON body.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Optional config entry id when multiple n8n instances are configured.

webhook_path.name: Webhook path
webhook_path.description: Optional n8n production webhook path override.

data.name: Data
data.description: Optional JSON object sent as the webhook or API execute request body. Prefer this over payload.

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: Alias for data — same JSON body if data is omitted.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Force a refresh of workflows from n8n.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Optional config entry id. Refreshes all entries when omitted.

create_inbound_secret.name: Create inbound secret
create_inbound_secret.description: Mint a new shared secret for the inbound HA webhook. Shown once in a notification; existing secrets keep working on the same URL.

label.name: Label
label.description: Optional label to identify this secret later.

revoke_inbound_secret.name: Revoke inbound secret
revoke_inbound_secret.description: Revoke one inbound webhook secret by id. At least one secret must remain.

secret_id.name: Secret ID
secret_id.description: Id of the secret to revoke.

rotate_inbound_secret.name: Rotate inbound secret
rotate_inbound_secret.description: Create a new inbound secret (shown once) and revoke previous ones.

label.name: Label
label.description: Optional label for the new secret.

revoke_secret_id.name: Revoke secret ID
revoke_secret_id.description: Optional specific secret id to revoke after creating the new one.

revoke_all_others.name: Revoke all others
revoke_all_others.description: When true, only the new secret remains valid.
